correctness.rationale: Full support-containment check for arbitrary dual factor directions uses q_i+C_ii=tau_i^2 and strictly positive barycentric coordinates. Positive lifted factor John weights satisfy both global first/second moments through C diag(tau)^(-1) C=C/d, thereby proving unrestricted maximum-volume and uniqueness. Equality analysis accounts for every boundary contact and excludes apex contacts. Exact rational checker independently passed 360 dimension profiles.
